description: Add or update an external .ics or webcal:// calendar (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple Calendar) and sync its events onto the Spica Post calendar (Studio and Pro, up to 5 per workspace).

brandId.description: The brand this is for, by its id from brands_list. Needed when the login has more than one brand; with one brand it can be left out.

color.description: A dot colour hex from the supported palette.

enabled.description: false hides the external calendar’s events without removing it.

id.description: An existing synced calendar id from calendars_list to update. Leave out to add a new external calendar.

name.description: A short name for this external calendar, up to 80 characters, such as "Client Launches".

url.description: The public or secret https:// or webcal:// iCalendar (.ics) address, up to 2048 characters. Required when adding a new calendar.

name: calendars_external_save
title: Save an external calendar
